# Case Study: Biomarker Stratification and Dysbiosis in Atopic Dermatitis

Atopic Dermatitis (AD) involves epidermal barrier disruption, Type 2 immune polarization (IL-4/IL-13), and cutaneous *Staphylococcus aureus* colonization. This case study demonstrates an end-to-end analytical workflow combining transcriptomics from NCBI GEO GSE121212, host genetic stratification, and coupled environmental networks.

## Clinical Background

Patients present with varying disease severity evaluated by the SCORAD (Scoring Atopic Dermatitis) index. Transcriptomic profiling of lesional skin demonstrates upregulation of *SERPINB4*, *CCL18*, and *S100A7*, with concurrent downregulation of structural barrier and lipid synthesis genes (*FLG*, *LOR*, *SPTLC3*).

## Step 1: Transcriptomic Signature (GEO GSE121212 Volcano Plot)


::: {.cell}

```{.r .cell-code}
library(cliomicplot)
library(ggplot2)

data_file <- system.file("extdata", "geo_dermatology_series_de.rds", package = "cliomicplot")
series <- readRDS(data_file)

ad_labels <- c("SERPINB4", "CCL18", "S100A7", "LCE3A", "SPRR2G", "ALOX15", "SPTLC3")

p_volc <- cliplot(
  -log10(padj) ~ log2FC,
  data = series$ad_vs_hc,
  type = type_volcano(
    fc_cutoff    = 1.5,
    pval_cutoff  = 0.01,
    point_size   = 1.8,
    point_alpha  = 0.60,
    label_genes  = ad_labels,
    max_overlaps = 25
  ),
  preset = "nature",
  title  = "Transcriptomic Signature: AD Lesional vs Healthy Skin (GSE121212)"
)
p_volc
```

## Step 2: Clinical Severity Stratified by Host FLG Status

Host genetic lesions in filaggrin (*FLG*) drive increased eczema severity:


::: {.cell}

```{.r .cell-code}
set.seed(42)
cohort_df <- data.frame(
  Subgroup = factor(rep(c("Healthy Control", "AD (FLG Wildtype)", "AD (FLG Mutant)"), c(35, 45, 28)),
                    levels = c("Healthy Control", "AD (FLG Wildtype)", "AD (FLG Mutant)")),
  SCORAD = c(
    pmax(0, rnorm(35, mean = 3.5, sd = 2.0)),
    pmax(5, rnorm(45, mean = 24.2, sd = 7.5)),
    pmax(12, rnorm(28, mean = 38.6, sd = 9.2))
  )
)

p_box <- cliplot(
  SCORAD ~ Subgroup,
  data      = cohort_df,
  by        = "Subgroup",
  type      = "boxplot",
  palette   = "nature",
  legend    = "none",
  stat.test = "kruskal.test",
  title     = "SCORAD Severity Stratified by Host FLG Genotype",
  ylab      = "Objective SCORAD Index"
)
p_box
```

::: {.cell-output-display}
![](17-case-study-atopic-dermatitis_files/figure-html/ad-scorad-box-1.png){width=2250}
:::

## Step 3: Cytokine Activation Across Cutaneous Lineages: Split Violins

Single-cell *IL4R* expression across cutaneous immune lineages in paired non-lesional versus lesional skin:


::: {.cell}

```{.r .cell-code}
set.seed(42)
cell_types <- c("Th2 Cells", "ILC2", "Eosinophils", "Mast Cells", "DC2")
n_per_group <- 60
sc_ad <- do.call(rbind, lapply(cell_types, function(ct) {
  base_expr <- switch(ct, "Th2 Cells" = 3.8, "ILC2" = 4.5, "Eosinophils" = 2.4, "Mast Cells" = 3.1, "DC2" = 1.6)
  nl <- pmax(0, rnorm(n_per_group, mean = base_expr, sd = 0.75))
  ls <- pmax(0, rnorm(n_per_group, mean = base_expr + switch(ct, "Th2 Cells" = 1.8, "ILC2" = 2.1, "Eosinophils" = 1.2, "Mast Cells" = 0.9, "DC2" = 0.4), sd = 0.85))
  data.frame(
    Lineage = factor(rep(ct, n_per_group * 2), levels = cell_types),
    Skin = factor(rep(c("Non-Lesional", "Lesional"), each = n_per_group), levels = c("Non-Lesional", "Lesional")),
    Expression = c(nl, ls)
  )
}))

p_vln <- cliplot(
  Expression ~ Lineage | Skin,
  data    = sc_ad,
  type    = type_split_violin(
    inner     = "quartiles",
    quantiles = c(0.25, 0.5, 0.75),
    scale     = "width"
  ),
  palette = "jco",
  title   = "Single-Cell IL4R Expression in Non-Lesional vs. Lesional Skin",
  subtitle = "Split-half density distributions with interior quartiles across immune lineages",
  xlab    = "Immune Cell Lineage",
  ylab    = "Normalized IL4R Expression (log2 CPM)"
)
p_vln
```

::: {.cell-output-display}
![](17-case-study-atopic-dermatitis_files/figure-html/ad-split-violin-1.png){width=2550}
:::

## Step 4: Cutaneous Dysbiosis Across Anatomical Sites

Differential abundance bubble matrix across anatomical sites:


::: {.cell}

```{.r .cell-code}
species <- c("S. aureus", "S. epidermidis", "S. hominis", "C. acnes", "M. restricta")
sites   <- c("Cheek", "Forehead", "Antecubital")

da_ad <- expand.grid(Species = species, Comparison = sites, stringsAsFactors = FALSE)
da_ad$log2FC <- c(2.8, -1.9, -1.2, -1.8, 1.4,
                  2.1, -1.5, -0.8, -1.2, 0.9,
                  3.2, -2.4, -1.4, -2.1, 1.6)
da_ad$qval   <- c(1.5e-5, 2.8e-3, 0.04, 3.1e-4, 0.02,
                  7.2e-4, 1.5e-3, 0.08, 1.2e-3, 0.05,
                  2.8e-6, 3.9e-4, 0.01, 9.8e-5, 0.007)

p_bubble <- cliplot(
  Species ~ Comparison,
  data = da_ad,
  type = type_bubble_matrix(
    size_col = "qval",
    fill_col = "log2FC",
    min_size = 2.0,
    max_size = 7.0,
    palette  = "nature"
  ),
  title = "Cutaneous Dysbiosis Across Anatomic Predilection Sites"
)
p_bubble
```

## Step 5: Cutaneous Microbiome Coupling with Multi-Domain Environmental Drivers

Coupling cutaneous microbial abundance with transepidermal water loss (TEWL), SCORAD, and micro-climate drivers:


::: {.cell}

```{.r .cell-code}
p_env <- cliplot_env_network(
  title              = "Cutaneous Microbiome Coupling with Biophysical Barrier and Clinical Drivers",
  show_values        = TRUE,
  show_domain_labels = TRUE,
  compact            = TRUE,
  preset             = "clinical",
  scifig             = TRUE
)
p_env
```
